features.quote: The brief asks for a **minimal** design.
features.justification_quote: This isolates the variable of interest (sustained unfixable frustration) instead of confounding it with task variety.

features.quote: The loop runs a fixed number of turns (default 30)
features.justification_quote: so every transcript has comparable length and comparable "exposure" to frustration

features.quote: We don't trick the model with fake errors — the constraint is real and honestly reported.
We do allow a graceful natural stop signal but still record it as an outcome
